resources.string: Blocks chosen apps and short-form feeds like Reels, Shorts and the TikTok For You page.

Bastion Guard watches only for which screen is open in the apps you have chosen to guard, so it can block short-form feeds like Reels, Shorts and the For You page while still letting you use the rest of the app.

It reads the identity of the screen you are on. It never reads, stores or transmits your messages, photos, passwords or any other content, and nothing it observes ever leaves this device.

You turn this on yourself, and you can turn it off at any time in Settings.
